tweets.text:
Some other big differences: 

- Connect any provider, sub, or model
- Use it completely free on your own machine or with one of the several free models on Nous Portal
- Switch between bots mode and classic sessions mode
- Self-improving agents that learn to execute tasks cheaper and more effectively
- Open Source so you can modify anything you want about the agent itself to suit your needs

Hermes Agent has its own remote computer too, you just aren’t locked in to using it and it costs a few dollars per month instead of $200.
